test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_text_index_like_guards ( s String, INDEX idx_s (s) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_text_index_like_guards SELECT concat('common ', 'medium' || intDiv(number, 1000), ' rare' || number) FROM numbers(2000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_like_guards WHERE s LIKE '%common%'
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_like_guards WHERE s ILIKE '%COMMON%'
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_like_guards WHERE s LIKE '%medium1%'
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_like_guards WHERE s LIKE '%rare1234567%'
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_like_guards WHERE s LIKE '%nonexistent%'
